`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. I ran it against the current data and it returns two people:

```
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  (54 days)
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  (32 days)
```

- **Ordering:** longest-idle first, so the people most at risk are at the top.
- **Columns:** each line shows last login date and days idle instead of the course list that `list` and `course` print.
- **Cutoff:** a learner at exactly 14 days is included. The threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant near the top of `roster.py`.

I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
